notes.title: Major Atlas Mystery Update
notes.notes:
[h1]The Atlas Mystery – Major Update (Hint System + Quality of Life Improvements)[/h1]

Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce the latest major update to [i]The Atlas Mystery[/i]—an exciting new feature that enhances gameplay, making the experience even more immersive and enjoyable! After closely monitoring player feedback and hearing your thoughts, we've been hard at work implementing changes that will elevate your adventure to new heights.

Here’s a breakdown of what you can expect in this update:

[h2]Introducing the New Intuitive Hint System[/h2]

One of the most requested features has now been added: a completely revamped, intuitive hint system designed to assist players in their journey through The Atlas Mystery without taking away the sense of discovery. We understand that unraveling the story behind the mysterious Atlas Theater can be challenging, and this system will help guide you through the more intricate puzzles while keeping the atmosphere and immersion intact.

How does it work?

Dynamic Suggestions: When you’re stuck on a puzzle or unsure of what to do next, the hint system will give you subtle, in-context nudges based on your current location and the puzzles you’ve solved so far. The hints will never give away the solution outright, so your sense of accomplishment remains intact.

Non-Intrusive Design: The hint system is completely optional and non-invasive. Hints can be accessed through a simple button prompt, allowing players to choose when and how much help they need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41415822/5e52d99ef27adffafbd26031a96e1dcecac4079d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41415822/3c6d5e0b8dcf3528155e88158eae17966db6494a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]

In addition to the hint system, we’ve made numerous quality of life updates that enhance gameplay fluidity and overall enjoyment. These improvements come directly from community feedback and our team's desire to polish every aspect of the game:

Refined Movement Controls: We’ve smoothed out the movement mechanics, making locomotion around the Atlas Theater more intuitive and less jarring. Whether you're using teleport or smooth movement, the experience should now feel much more natural.

Improved Interaction System: Picking up and interacting with objects in the environment has been optimized for better precision and fewer accidental actions. This will make puzzle-solving smoother, with fewer interruptions to your experience.

Enhanced Visual and Audio Cues: We’ve added subtle visual and audio cues that make navigating the theater and understanding puzzle mechanics easier, without detracting from the eerie atmosphere of the game. These cues will help guide you to important objects and areas without breaking immersion.

Revamped Tutorial: Based on player feedback, we’ve reworked the introductory tutorial to better explain the game’s mechanics while keeping the pace brisk. New players will find the game easier to grasp, while returning players can still dive right into the story.

Optimized Performance: We’ve fine-tuned the game for better performance on a range of systems, reducing loading times and increasing frame rates. Whether you’re playing on high-end hardware or something more modest, the game should now run smoother than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41415822/3ab69a37414085c3f9f610d83bd4b231de88777b.png[/img]
[h2]
A Message of Gratitude[/h2]

We want to take a moment to express our deep gratitude to our incredible community. Your tenacity, creativity, and loyalty have helped shape The Atlas Mystery into what it is today. From the feedback on our forums to the detailed bug reports and feature suggestions, your involvement has been invaluable. We hear you, and we're committed to continually improving the game based on your input.

We know the journey through the Atlas Theater has been challenging, but it’s your dedication that has pushed us to make these enhancements. As we look ahead, rest assured that we’ll continue to refine the game and introduce new features that further enrich the experience.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

Stay tuned—this update is just the beginning. We’ve got more content planned for the future, including additional story elements, expanded puzzle mechanics, and even new areas to explore. If you have suggestions or feedback on this update, don’t hesitate to share them with us. We’re always listening and excited to see what ideas you come up with.

Thank you for being a part of The Atlas Mystery! We can’t wait to see how you enjoy the new hint system and improvements.

See you in the Atlas Theater!

[b]— The Atlas Mystery Development Team[/b]

notes.title: Steam VR Showcase Game Update July 7.15.22
notes.notes:
In advance of the Steam VR Showcase launching in a few days, we are posting a new version updated based on feedback from the Steam Summer sale. Thanks again for all of your feedback. Sometimes making small changes can make a huge difference. 

Here are some of the changes:


[list]
[*] Collision improvements on certain items
[*] Minor visual improvements
[*] Improved Radio Puzzle usability
[*] Fixed item gravity bug
[*] Improved certain key usability
[*] Changed noise when putting key into backpack
[*] Fixed being able to teleport with certain items you were not meant to
[*] Minor performance improvements
[*] Added some clarity to tutorial
[/list]

If you have any (spoiler free) feedback for the Top Right Corner team on [i]The Atlas Mystery,[/i] please let us know! We love making VR games for you!
